eval_id.description: Unique identifier for this evaluation; used as folder name under runs/<run_id>/eval/.

run_id.description: Run ID or path to run directory to evaluate. Must exist under runs/ or be an absolute path.

dataset_root.description: Path to dataset root directory containing metadata/, sketches/, and the reference HTML.

ids.description: Optional explicit list of sample IDs to evaluate. If null or not provided, evaluates all samples in the run.

metrics.description: List of metric names to run for each sample.

timeout_ms.description: Default timeout for browser operations in milliseconds.

judge.description: LLM judge configuration for llm_judge_screenshots and accessible metrics.

provider.description: LLM provider for judge. 'hf' loads the model directly via transformers and runs inference in-process (see HF_* env vars in providers/hf_provider.py). Set to null to disable judge.

model.description: Model identifier for the judge provider (e.g., OpenAI: 'gpt-4o', 'gpt-5.2'; Claude: 'claude-sonnet-4-6'). Required if provider is not null.

prompt.description: Jinja2 template ID for the judge prompt, relative to src/responsive/eval/prompts/ without .j2 extension. Used by llm_judge_screenshots to select the responsive scoring rubric. Defaults to 'llm_judge/unified_responsive_v1'.

prompt_vars.description: Optional key-value pairs passed as Jinja2 template variables when rendering the judge prompt. Merge with and override metric-supplied defaults.

response_format.description: API-level JSON mode. Set to 'json_object' to enable structured JSON output on providers that support it (OpenAI, vLLM). Strongly recommended when using small models that don't reliably follow JSON instructions. Accepts the string shorthand 'json_object' (expanded to {"type": "json_object"} internally).

system_prompt.description: Optional system message prepended before the user turn. Use '/no_think' to disable Qwen3 chain-of-thought reasoning (prevents the model from spending all tokens on <think> blocks and returning an empty response).

extra_body.description: Provider-specific extra parameters passed directly to the API request body (vLLM only). Example: {"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": false}} disables Qwen3 thinking at the chat-template level, which is more reliable than the /no_think system prompt.

include_sketches.description: Whether to include desktop and mobile sketch images as judge inputs. Set to false to use screenshot-only evaluation (3 images: mobile, tablet, desktop). When false, use a sketch-free prompt such as 'llm_judge/sketch_free_v1'. Defaults to true.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of attempts for each judge API call. On non-JSON or any other error the call is retried with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s, …). Defaults to 3.

iou_threshold.description: Minimum IoU for a generated block to be matched to a reference block of the same category. Pairs below this are left unmatched (contributing to false positives/negatives) rather than matched.

overwrite.description: If true, overwrite existing evaluation results. If false, skip samples with existing metrics.json.

concurrency.description: Concurrency configuration for parallel metric execution.

max_workers.description: Maximum number of concurrent workers for metric execution.

skip_if_metrics_exist.description: If true, skip samples that already have metrics.json (unless overwrite is true). Failed samples are retried.

level.description: Log level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR.

file_path.description: Custom log file path (relative to eval directory). If null, defaults to eval.log.
